provenance: Synthetic offline ARM64 guest execution of native classifier, packet queues, ACK serializer and QoS encoder; not a drone capture
stubbed_boundaries: type1 parser SW_Alg_Recv_Deal_Win: capture 8-byte input, no receiver state mutation
type1 parser SW_Alg_Send_Deal_Ack: capture decoded ACK arguments, no sender mutation
type1 receive thread exit: skip connection teardown, execute epilogue

limits: Receiver-window update and legacy sender ACK callbacks capture arguments without mutation
Thread shutdown skips connection teardown; encoding, field offsets and DUML callback execute natively
SYN-derived FEC configuration is seeded at both values; these probes validate parsing, not FEC recovery

ack_state_notes: start/end and status words are read back from guest receiver memory
missing lists status0 packet bases; mixed profile injects partial FEC status words separately from pending delta
unreported_missing_delta is the native one-shot pending list at receiver+0xd0
already_reported lists initial pending delta entries consumed by earlier ACK serialization; both compressed and list serialization consume this native delta
priority6 precedes priority4 within each shared context, so priority4 starts after priority6 and its second emission
limits: Does not prove live drone acceptance, telemetry or flight readiness
Session and receiver state are synthetic guest memory, not full SDK connection lifecycle
Mutex calls are single-thread no-ops; no scheduler thread is created
Encoder called directly; thread scheduling order is a separate static observation
